component.name: Suno SDK
component.summary: Compilers, headers and tools for building Suno applications

description.p: The Suno SDK is the development runtime matching the Suno Platform. It is built from the same Fedora 44 packages as the Suno operating system, including Suno's GTK 4, libadwaita, the Suno Developer Platform, the Prairie icon theme and Suno's fonts, so an application looks and behaves the same on Suno and on any other distribution with Flatpak.
